cinematicReductionHandoff.policy: Video is reserved for physical action, major reveals, world change, important entrances, rescue/failure outcomes, climaxes and spectacle. Talking begins only after transition to STATIC_TABLEAU.

entries.title: Chronique cinématique
entries.justification: Manifest-only QA placeholder with no production video source.

entries.title: Le Jugement du Lion
entries.justification: Major judgement and route-climax ceremony.

entries.title: Le Général du Serpent
entries.justification: Boss entrance belongs to the combat handoff, never to dialogue.

entries.title: Le Champion du Lion
entries.justification: Champion entrance belongs to the combat handoff, never to dialogue.

entries.title: Pression sous les frondaisons
entries.justification: Atmospheric movement is route texture rather than a major story action.

entries.title: Le départ du camp
entries.justification: Opening departure establishes the company and begins the Lion chapter.

entries.title: L’audience d’Alaric
entries.justification: Major court entrance and Audience ceremony; all dialogue starts afterward.

entries.title: Les réfugiés sur la route
entries.justification: The refugee arrival can retain motion as a brief encounter reveal before tableau dialogue.

entries.title: Le premier refuge
entries.justification: Arrival establishes a new refuge location before management and dialogue.

entries.title: Vers la piste de la réserve
entries.justification: Route departure is travel continuity, not a dramatic action beat.

entries.title: La route de Valmir
entries.justification: The fork is persistent route geography best held as a travel still.

entries.title: Bois-Clair sous les flammes
entries.justification: Bois-Clair burning is a major physical event and world-state reveal.

entries.title: Bois-Clair sauvée
entries.justification: Major rescue outcome visibly changes the village state.

entries.title: Le prix de Bois-Clair
entries.justification: Major failure outcome visibly changes the village and refugee state.

entries.title: La marche reprend
entries.justification: Route departure is travel continuity, not a major dramatic action.

entries.title: Les témoins de la route
entries.justification: The beat is witness testimony and decision context.

entries.title: L’approche des ruines
entries.justification: The ruins approach is dialogue-free environmental punctuation before danger.

entries.title: Les signes des Ombres
entries.justification: The core content is Seraphine and Elara interpreting evidence.

entries.title: Le dernier dossier
entries.justification: The dossier is a sustained company discussion and evidence review.

entries.title: La chute du Général Serpent
entries.justification: Route climax and ending-state spectacle.

entries.title: Le Sceau par l’épreuve
entries.justification: Route climax and Lion recognition ceremony.

entries.title: Cedric au carrefour
entries.justification: Recruitment negotiation is character dialogue.

entries.title: La lance de Garen
entries.justification: Recruitment negotiation is character dialogue.

entries.title: Pression des Serpents
entries.justification: Enemy reveal belongs to the following tactical-combat handoff.

entries.title: Le sanctuaire intact
entries.justification: The intact shrine is a compact environmental reveal before a tableau choice.

entries.title: Le marchand blessé
entries.justification: The player-facing content is a conversation and aid decision.

entries.title: Le chariot abandonné
entries.justification: The marked cart is a compact physical clue reveal before inspection dialogue.

entries.title: Le nid venimeux
entries.justification: Creature reveal belongs to the tactical-combat setup.

entries.title: Le duelliste Serpent
entries.justification: Duelist entrance belongs to the tactical-combat setup.
